name: Droid Incredible

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.1 (Eclair) , upgradeable to Android 2.3.4 (Gingerbread) as of September 15, 2011

Memory.Storage: 1 GB ROM (748 MB free to user) plus 8 GB moviNAND
Memory.Card slot: microSD 2.0 memory card (supports up to 32 GB)

Display.Display: 3.7-inch 480 × 800 px WVGA AMOLED or super TFT LCD (S-LCD) at 252 ppi

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi (802.11b/g); Bluetooth 2.1 with A2DP stereo and EDR; A-GPS; FM tuner, 3.5 mm TRSS connector, micro-USB, mobile MiFi Verizon Wireless hotspot
